culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Shoko Hisazu. She poisoned Ushigome by swapping the bottle cap with the poisoned one that she prepared ahead of time while using a potato chip bag as a cover.

motive.quote: She murdered him because she didn't want Ushigome to turn himself in due to the accident that he caused as it would have damaged her and her friends' reputation.

method.quote: She poisoned Ushigome by swapping the bottle cap with the poisoned one that she prepared ahead of time while using a potato chip bag as a cover.

evidence.quote: Back then when they were driving they felt as if they had hit something, but when they got out of the car and searched they apparently found nothing or no one.

motive.zhHans: 她杀他，是因为不想让 Ushigome 为那起由他造成的事故而自首——那会毁掉她和她朋友们的名声。
motive.en: She murdered him because she didn't want Ushigome to turn himself in due to the accident that he caused as it would have damaged her and her friends' reputation.

method.zhHans: 她用一片薯片袋作遮挡，把瓶盖换成了她事先准备好的涂毒瓶盖，从而毒死了 Ushigome。
method.en: She poisoned Ushigome by swapping the bottle cap with the poisoned one that she prepared ahead of time while using a potato chip bag as a cover.

evidence.zhHans: 当年他们开车时，感觉好像撞到了什么东西；但下车搜寻时，显然既没找到什么、也没看到人。于是他们以为可能只是动物之类，然而 Shoko 其实在灌木丛里看到过一个男人，却什么也没说，认为他已经死了。后来他们听新闻说，在他们搜寻过的那个地方发现了一名死者的尸体，只当是巧合；但 Ushigome 心里明白，愧疚积压太久，他终于决定去自首。
evidence.en: Back then when they were driving they felt as if they had hit something, but when they got out of the car and searched they apparently found nothing or no one. So they assumed it was possibly a animal or something, however Shoko had found a man in the bushes but said nothing believing he was already dead. But when they heard on the news that a man had been found dead where they had searched they thought it was a coincidence, but Ushigome knew better and had been guilt ridden for so long that he decided to turn himself in.

Back then when they were driving they felt as if they had hit something, but when they got out of the car and searched they apparently found nothing or no one. So they assumed it was possibly a animal or something, however Shoko had found a man in the bushes but said nothing believing he was already dead.
